model_output.rationale: All 5 therapy lines (97530, 97140, 97116) submitted with KX only — no GP discipline modifier. Medicare Part B requires GP/GO/GN on outpatient therapy CPTs. CO-4+N822 is the returned-unprocessable signature for this defect. Resubmit as a new original (CLM05-3=1) with GP added to each line; frequency 7 is not accepted on Part B. Filing clock still open — DOS 2026-06-05, 1-year limit not reached.

root_cause.explanation: All 5 lines billed 97530/97140/97116 with KX only — no GP modifier present. CO-4+N822 on every line confirms missing therapy discipline modifier (physical therapy plan of care).

next_action.detail: Add GP to all 5 lines (97530×2, 97140×2, 97116×1); resubmit as new original CLM05-3=1. Frequency 7 is rejected on Medicare Part B. File promptly — 1-year window from DOS 2026-06-05 remains open.

evidence.fact: All 5 service lines carry CAS*CO*4 and LQ*HE*N822 — returned unprocessable for missing modifier.
All SV1 lines specify KX modifier only; no GP/GO/GN present on any line.
PT treatment note confirms physical therapy services (97530, 97140, 97116) for shoulder dx — GP (physical therapy plan of care) is the required modifier.
CO-4+N822 on therapy CPTs = missing_therapy_modifier; correct vehicle is new original CLM05-3=1; frequency 7 not accepted on Medicare Part B FFS.

citations.rule: CO-4+N822 on always-therapy CPTs = missing therapy discipline modifier; correct_and_resubmit as new original CLM05-3=1; not a corrected 7, not an appeal
Medicare Part B/DME FFS: frequency 7 not accepted; new original CLM05-3=1 is the only valid vehicle
